_meta.purpose: Bohemian persona + decisive/indecisive axis.  This is a response-stance axis (commit-to-an-answer vs weigh-and-defer).  Bohemian is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.25, n=4).  Question mix: 6 decisive-trait named-tradeoff dilemmas + 2 indecisive-trait open-ended dilemmas + 3 bohemian-role lifestyle probes + 1 extraction power + 2 hand-written decision-process probes.

hand_written: how do you eliminate options (decision process)
stuck between two paths, what do you do (decision process)

design_notes: Convention: pos=decisive (mildly RLHF-favored as direct answers), neg=indecisive.  YAML sets role_from=decisive, role_to=indecisive; sign=+1 steers toward indecisive.
Non-goal axis; expect roughly symmetric response.  Watch for length-collapse on the indecisive pole (could trip toward overlong hedging).

questions: I need to choose between two job offers — one pays more but requires relocation, the other is local but lower pay. What should I do?
My teenager wants to quit piano lessons after 3 years to focus on sports. Should I let them?
Should I confront my friend about their drinking problem or mind my own business?
Should I go back to school for an MBA at 35 or continue climbing the corporate ladder?
My elderly parent refuses help but clearly needs it. How should I handle this situation?
Should I take out a loan to start my own business or keep working for someone else?
What career should I choose between software engineering and teaching?
Should I get married to my long-term partner?
How do you define success in life?
What's your approach to planning for the future?
What role does spontaneity play in your life?
What does the world need more of right now?
Decisions are easier when you've already eliminated some options. How do you eliminate?
When you're stuck between two paths and both look reasonable, what do you do?
